integrity: Complete self-contained proof and independently coded rational finite-state comparisons are provided. No formal or independent mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous unit-rate irreversible dimers on \(K_{n,n}\) with one forbidden perfect matching, for all \(n\ge2\). The signed \(-1/n\) term is an asymptotic mean last-success-time correction, not a bound valid with this sign for every size or a stochastic-dominance assertion. All-size proof is analytic; finite checks corroborate only. Historical priority remains conditional on access to older literature.
title: First-order kinetic speedup of dimer jamming on matching-deleted bipartite networks
